concerns.text: Tasks T065-T069 (collaboration_density, review_latency_variance, interaction pattern analysis) have no corresponding FR or SC in spec.md. The spec defines FR-001..FR-008 and SC-001..SC-009, none of which authorize these new metrics or the 'Emergent Interaction Patterns' analysis. Implementing them violates the Single Source of Truth principle.

Task T069 requires updating the Limitations section to acknowledge inability to capture 'physiological proxies (pupil dilation, HRV)'. Spec.md SC-009 and SC-006 only mandate disclosure of proxy metrics and NASA-TLX unavailability. Adding un-authorized physiological limitation claims creates a gap between spec scope and task deliverables.

Task T067 requires a linear regression correlation test for 'collaboration_density'. Spec.md FR-003 mandates Mixed-Effects Models (GLMM) and Zero-Inflated models for primary outcomes. A simple linear regression for an un-authorized metric is not covered by the statistical modeling requirements, creating a gap in statistical rigor validation.

Phase 10 tasks reference 'David Krakauer's concern' and 'reviewer feedback' as the source for new requirements, but these concerns are not reflected as formal FR/SC updates in spec.md. The tasks should either be removed or the spec.md must be updated to include the corresponding requirements before implementation.
